OUR SPECIALISED SERVICES

Complete Solutions Across The Railway Lifecycle

From preliminary feasibility and circuit drafting to SIL-4 safety documentation and station commissioning, AAV Works delivers certified railway signalling and interlocking services for modern rail networks.

CORE DISCIPLINE 01

Railway Signalling & Circuit Engineering

Our proficient engineering team specializes in crafting robust, fail-safe circuits that serve as the bedrock of Railway Signalling infrastructure across all major modern signalling technologies:

Electronic Interlocking (EI) Design Scheme plans, Selection tables (Table of Control), VDU Control Layouts, Application Logic, and Interface Circuits.
Automatic Train Protection (ATP) & Kavach / TCAS Kavach / TCAS Designing, ETCS Level 1 & 2 Designing, PTC, and Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC).
Independent Verification (Proof Consultancy) Licensed IRSE / IRSTELO consultants who have completed 100+ Independent Verification activities across Indian Railways.
Inquire About Engineering Services →
CORE DISCIPLINE 02

Turnkey Projects & Station Commissioning

Our dedicated project engineers have successfully installed and commissioned more than 350+ stations across India, covering diverse OEM technologies including Medha, Kyosan, Ansaldo/Hitachi, and Siemens.

Installation & Erection Track circuits, axle counters, point machines, and multi-aspect signals with zero-defect cabling.
Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) Rigorous functional testing, square sheets, and interlocking cross-verification under live rail conditions.
Safety Audits & CRS Regulatory Dossiers Complete as-built documentation, CRS sanction dossiers, and safety audit signoffs.
Engage Commissioning Team →
CORE DISCIPLINE 03

System Assurance & RAMS Management

RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, Safety) management stands at the very center of our technical assurance services, complying strictly with international CENELEC standards.

CENELEC Standards Compliance EN 50126 (RAMS lifecycle), EN 50128 (Software for railway control), and EN 50129 (Safety electronic systems).
Hazard Log & Safety Cases FMECA, fault tree analysis, preliminary hazard analysis, and SIL-4 Safety Case preparation.
Proven Global MNC Engagements PSD SIL 2 Documentation for Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) and Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor (EDFC) for Siemens.
Consult With RAMS Specialists →
CORE DISCIPLINE 04

Rail Software & Signalling Automation

We build custom software tools that eliminate tedious, error-prone manual drafting tasks. From automated Boolean logic generation to interactive trainee traffic simulators, our software enhances rail efficiency and zero-defect deployments.
